mapper.insert: insert into `user`(address, parent_address, `status`, nickname, head_url, invite_num, register_ip, register_time) VALUES (#{address}, #{parentAddress}, #{status}, #{nickname}, #{headUrl}, #{inviteNum}, #{registerIp}, #{registerTime})
mapper.update:
update `user`
parent_address = #{parentAddress},
`status` = #{status},
nickname = #{nickname},
head_url = #{headUrl},
latest_login_ip = #{latestLoginIp},
latest_login_time = #{latestLoginTime},
where address = #{address}
